title: Junior → AI System Architect
intro: The same shape applies to every path — only the technical depth changes. Each rung is a step up in the size of the ambiguity you are trusted to absorb, not a count of years served.
closing: The last stage of every path points at this same ladder. There are not seven architect tracks: one sits above all of them, because at that level the job becomes system-level judgement rather than language or framework specifics.

levels.title: Junior
levels.guidance: Follow the roadmap exactly, complete every project listed, and focus on correctness over cleverness.

levels.title: Mid-level
levels.guidance: Start making architecture choices on your own projects — why RAG vs fine-tuning, why this vector DB, why this framework.

levels.title: Senior
levels.guidance: Think in tradeoffs, not tutorials — reliability, cost, latency and security become your job rather than an afterthought. Mentor others.

levels.title: Lead / Staff
levels.guidance: Own cross-team technical direction, write design docs before code, and evaluate build-vs-buy.

levels.title: AI System Architect
levels.focus: Own org-wide AI strategy and platform
levels.scope: Diagrams and decision records over code; cost, risk and scale owner
levels.guidance: Own the end-to-end system — model and provider selection, scaling strategy, governance, cost ceilings, and how AI investment ties to business value. Works in diagrams and decision records as much as code.
